steps.clueRiddle:
Last summer you raced across two provinces.
Today the whole race fits inside one house!
steps.clueReveal: Stand by the front door with your team. Answer three warm-up questions. Then step on the mat to meet your rivals.

challenges.title: Champion's Warm-Up
challenges.instructions: Three quick questions before the race. A champion remembers everything. Guessing is still allowed!

trivia.q: Which team did you beat in last summer's photo finish?
trivia.funFact: They have been training all year for this rematch.

trivia.q: Where is today's whole race happening?
trivia.funFact: Five legs, one house. No long car rides this time!

trivia.q: What do you rip open to get your next clue?
trivia.funFact: Yellow and red envelopes, just like the real show.

steps.funFact: Defending champions always get introduced last. That is you now.

steps.clueRiddle:
Four old rivals are waiting on the mat.
They want that trophy back!
steps.clueReveal: Step onto the mat by the front door. The host has news. Your four rivals are BACK for a rematch season.
steps.funFact: Warm-up points do not count. The real season starts at the kitchen.
